title: What is a peptide?
definition: A peptide is a molecule made from amino-acid building blocks joined by peptide bonds. The name alone does not tell you what a particular product will do.
context: On Peptivelo, a peptide profile describes a named identity or form. An ingredient is a component listed in a formulation. A finished product is the complete formulation sold in a particular presentation. Research about one component is a different question from testing that finished product.
reading: Start with the identity and context, then ask what was actually studied. Open the source notes to distinguish terminology, manufacturer information, laboratory work and human research.
